name: ChainSea Information Integration Co.,Ltd.
summary: Based in Taipei, Taiwan, ChainSea Information Integration Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of business solutions focused on customer relationship management (CRM). Founded in 1993, the company's offerings encompass outsourced call center operations, specialized education and training for call center personnel, and professional consultation and advisory services. Furthermore, ChainSea acts as a distributor for network switch and call center system technologies. The firm also undertakes the installation and ongoing maintenance of critical systems, including call center infrastructure, CRM platforms, and advanced AI voice-activated dialing solutions.
